coreResponsibility.summary: A media source adapter plugin that integrates Google's Shaka Player library with the PlayKit JS Player to enable DASH (Dynamic Adaptive Streaming over HTTP) playback with DRM support.

featureOwnership: Adaptive Bitrate (ABR) streaming for DASH content
DASH thumbnail/image track extraction (I-Frame based thumbnails)
Live and VOD DASH stream handling
Stall detection and recovery for Smart TVs
dataHandling: Adaptation set extraction (video, audio, text, image)
DRM license acquisition and session management
Live edge calculation and seek range tracking

repositories.name: @playkit-js/playkit-js
repositories.description: Core PlayKit JS Player - provides BaseMediaSourceAdapter, event types, track models, and player infrastructure

services: Kaltura CDN (DASH manifest and segment delivery)

repositories.name: kaltura-player-js
repositories.description: Full-featured Kaltura Player that consumes this adapter for DASH playback

repositories.description: Provider layer that supplies media source configuration including DASH sources

consumers: OTT/OVP web players using PlayKit ecosystem
